_comment: Drift guard for the co-dependent equityFunding/lotSelector split (RSU-lot-order phase 1, docs/tools/rsu-lot-order-spec.md §2.4). These two files MUST stay byte-identical across optionsahoy_web and optionsahoy-mcp: equityFunding.ts imports lotSelector.ts, so a partial sync breaks the mcp build. This manifest is checked into BOTH repos; each repo verifies its local pair against it (mirror-manifest.test.ts). Regenerate with: node scripts/gen-calc-mirror-manifest.mjs. Other lib/calc files are intentionally NOT covered here — several already diverge between repos independent of this work.
